assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent static character standing portrait for a Japanese pixel-art hotel game, not a poster. Create ONE original adult woman receptionist, Mio, age about 27, sophisticated and kind, at a midnight Art Deco hotel. Full body head to shoes entirely visible, frontal three-quarter view looking toward the viewer, centered, generous transparent padding, no desk or scenery. Short dark espresso bob haircut with one small brass crescent hairclip, warm brown eyes, ivory blouse with neat collar, forest-green tailored waistcoat and below-knee straight skirt, slim burgundy ribbon tie, brass key brooch, dark stockings and simple closed shoes. Natural adult proportions about 6.5 heads tall, elegant and modest, NOT childlike chibi. Hands gently clasped around a small room-key tag at her waist. Expression: composed welcoming neutral, very slight smile, open eyes. Art direction: exquisite handcrafted 16/32-bit Japanese adventure RPG pixel-art standing portrait, native-looking crisp square pixel clusters, low resolution pixel logic around 180x360 character pixels upscaled nearest-neighbor, no vector smooth curves, no painterly blending, no glossy anime rendering, no 3D. Restrained palette of deep green #183c32, charcoal #10221d, champagne gold #ddc895, warm ivory #f2e7cc, muted burgundy #783c48. Warm readable face, careful cloth highlights, coherent pixel scale across face and body. Clean actual alpha-transparent background, no shadow plate, no text, no logos, no frame. This is the identity anchor for future expression variants; make the face clearly readable at mobile dialogue size.
